options: A search engine without a model
An ingest path (chunk, embed, store — on change) and a query path (embed, retrieve, assemble, answer — per request) meeting at an index
A fine-tuned model plus a cache
explanation: Two paths, one index; every later lesson improves one box.

stem: Why must the question be embedded with the same model as the documents?
options: Vectors from different models live in different spaces and compare to nothing
explanation: Same model both sides; a model change is a full re-index.

stem: What must the vector store hold for each chunk?
options: id, title/text, vector — and the embedding model version
explanation: The text comes back with the hit; the id is what answers cite; the model version guards the geometry.

stem: Passage ids in square brackets in the prompt exist so that…
options: The model can cite them and code can verify the citations

stem: Including 'reply exactly NOT_COVERED' in the prompt…
options: Gives the model a first-class way to say no, turning refusal into a normal, checkable outcome
explanation: Without it the model answers anything (2.6).

stem: Top-3 returns three unrelated articles with low, flat scores. This means…
options: Nothing fits — nearest-neighbour always returns k things; the refusal rule (or a threshold) turns 'least bad' into 'not covered'
explanation: Retrieval never returns nothing; the answer step must be allowed to say no.

options: The ceiling on answer quality — the model only sees what retrieval put in front of it
Irrelevant if the model is large
explanation: Ask 'which stage' before 'the model is bad'.

stem: Embedding title + text rather than bare text…
options: Carries context the passage alone may lack, improving retrieval
explanation: Lesson 6.3 makes 'prepend the title' a rule.

stem: The per-request embedding cost in RAG is…
explanation: Documents are embedded once at ingest; only the query is embedded per request.

stem: Retrieved passages are correct but the answer contradicts them. Which stage?
options: Generation/grounding — check the prompt the model received and run the faithfulness judge
explanation: Right passage, wrong use → the answer step, not retrieval.
